childNodes.textContent: Instead of using green paint mixed mechanically from yellow and blue, they applied yellow and blue unmixed in small dots, so that they became mixed only in our perception, as an impression.

These are only two colours. Make the dots smaller and they stop being dots and become one colour. At the smallest size each dot is a single point on your screen. You can also change how much of each there is.

childNodes.textContent: In the first case, 3 or 4 color plates subdivided into tiny printing dots mix to innumerable color shades and tints.

Every printed picture is an optical mixture. In colour there are only three inks, cyan, magenta and yellow, each on its own angled grid. In black and white there is one ink and the white of the paper. Make the screen finer and the dots turn into a picture.
